description:
What has been discovered and confirmed about winning products? Validated findings.
(¿Qué se ha descubierto y comprobado sobre los productos que triunfan?)

Each finding was discovered with some launches and then repeated in at least two 8-week periods with launches
the system had not seen. Includes statement, lift with 95 % interval, products, period, attribute family,
stability (1-3) and `cita`. On the free plan you see the 3 most stable per category; for the rest, the
statement without figures (`bloqueados`). Agency plan: also those under observation, marked `preliminar`.
Without a category: all of them.

Args:
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; empty = all).
    pais: country code (empty = all).
    lang: "es" (default) or "en" (attribute names in English; statements stay in Spanish for now).

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
